lede: The week's most consequential meeting is the San Miguel County Board of County Commissioners work session Tuesday, where Ouray County takes up Proposition 123's affordable housing commitment cycle and a Special Use Permit amendment in Colona — real decisions with regional reach. Norwood's Water Commission also has a packed Tuesday, including a formal complaint hearing and two executive sessions on legal matters. The Town of Telluride holds a three-hour budget work session Tuesday focused on housing, open space, and enterprise funds, and the Telluride Horror Show rolls in Friday with a public hearing on its alcohol permits already on the books.

notable.stake: Formal complaint hearing and contract votes on Norwood's water future.
Council works through 2027 budget including housing and open space spending.
County votes on Prop 123 housing commitment and a Colona Special Use Permit.
